subject: Mutual action plan & dependency owners for Helix Health close
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <s.gomez@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & dependency owners for Helix Health close

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call, I pulled together a lightweight mutual action plan so everyone has clear owners and dates for the MSA/DPA/order form path to signature. The goal: finish redlines, complete security review, and have a signed order form within the next 4 weeks if possible.

Quick summary of dependencies (attached as Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Legal redlines (MSA) — owner: Helix legal + Redwood legal (Karthik) — target: 2026-08-10
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — owner: Helix security + Redwood trust (Marissa) — target: 2026-08-14
- DPA alignment (data flows, retention) — owner: Helix privacy + Redwood legal — target: 2026-08-12
- Order form pricing approval & PO issuance — owner: Helix procurement — target: 2026-08-20

Can you confirm the Helix-side owners/dates above or suggest changes? If we can lock owners this week I’ll update the MAP, add a short gating checklist, and propose a DocuSign flow for the final MSA+Order Form.

Attachments: Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Helix_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (SOW for pilot)

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0146

From: Sara Gomez <s.gomez@helixhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix Health Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & dependency owners for Helix Health close

Jordan,

Appreciate the quick turn. I reviewed the MAP and this looks like a solid starting point. A few notes from procurement/security:

- Procurement will need an internal pricing approval (expected by 2026-08-11). If pricing holds, PO issuance target 2026-08-20 still looks realistic.
- Security: we raised a couple of DLP questions during the tech review (attached as inline comments). Our infosec lead, Priya Rao, would like to run the SOC2 artifact review — can Marissa share the specific evidence links?
- Legal: our counsel prefers to review the MSA redlines concurrently with the SOC2 artifacts; if both are green we can compress the legal review by a couple of days.

Owners on our side:
- Procurement: Aaron Patel <a.patel@helixhealth.com>
- Security/Infosec: Priya Rao <p.rao@helixhealth.com>
- Legal: Miguel Santos <m.santos@helixhealth.com>

I'll confirm internally and get back with firm PO timeline by end of day Tuesday.

Best,
Sara Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager | Helix Health
s.gomez@helixhealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <s.gomez@helixhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & dependency owners for Helix Health close

Sara —

Thanks for the clarity and the owners. A couple of points from Redwood legal:

1) Redlines: we will accept most commercial edits; there are two clauses we typically ask to keep as-is (liability cap tied to order value, and the indemnification carve-outs for open-source models). I can send a marked-up MSA by EOD Monday (2026-08-02).

2) DPA specifics: to speed review, Marissa can provide the SOC2 summary report and our data processing addendum language. If your privacy team has any non-standard retention asks please flag them now so we can bake them into the DPA draft.

3) Sequence recommendation: legal + security in parallel but legal signs off conditional on SOC2 artifacts being acceptable. That means a firm SOC2 review completion date gives legal the confidence to finalize quickly.

I’ll circulate the redline PDF and proposed fallback language for the two commercial points.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Updated MAP & proposed gating checklist (v1)

Sara / Aaron —

Quick update: attached is MAP v1 with owners updated per Sara’s note and an added gating checklist for sign-off. Highlights:
- SOC2 evidence links included (see map notes) — Marissa, please confirm the links are the final artifacts you want to share.
- MSA redline turnaround: Redwood legal to deliver marked-up MSA by 2026-08-02; Helix legal review target 2026-08-10
- Proposed DocuSign flow: Redwood to initiate combined MSA + order form DocuSign once Helix confirms legal sign-off and procurement confirms PO date.

Requested next steps this week:
1) Helix: confirm Aaron (procurement), Priya (infosec), Miguel (legal) as owners on the MAP
2) Redwood: Karthik will send redline PDF; Marissa will share SOC2 link; I’ll set up a shared calendar with the critical dates.

If we stick to these dates we should hit the 2026-08-20 order form target and have an executed MSA/DPA in flight concurrently.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Sara Gomez <s.gomez@helixhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Updated MAP & proposed gating checklist (v1)

Jordan —

All owners confirmed. Priya will take the SOC2 review (she’s copied) and Miguel will review redlines. Procurement (Aaron) confirmed internal pricing approval on 2026-08-11. We’ll aim to issue the PO the week of 2026-08-17 pending a final pricing sign-off.

A couple of small asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short one-page summary of deployment networking requirements to share with our infra team?
- If Redwood requires any specific language for the DPA retention clause, flag that now so Miguel can push it through legal quickly.

Once we have the SOC2 summary and the one-pager, we should be set to move to DocuSign the following week.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing.

Sara
